sayLines.text: 👀 You caught Somchai rehearsing — muttering details about Denver under their breath before the evening fire, like someone cramming for a part.
"You let something slip. Word is you were a Denver. You caught Somchai rehearsing — muttering details about Denver under their breath before the evening fire, like someone cramming for a part."
